# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

An open-source artist's book by Chris-Armel Iradukunda (daqhris): 263 photographs shot on walks across Belgium, 2017–2024, minted as tokens, with the writing that surrounds them. Text and photographs are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; source code is EUPL-1.2. The GitBook edition at {{ site.data.seo.canonical_host }} is the reference copy while this site is in trial.
